items.briefing:
Online scams continue to pose a growing risk for Australians, with AI-generated content making fake blogs and fraudulent websites increasingly convincing and harder to spot. Staff should be cautious about clicking links from unfamiliar websites, particularly those promoting deals, investment opportunities, or urgent requests. Separately, OpenAI has added a Computer History feature to ChatGPT on macOS, which stores a record of your activity — worth reviewing your privacy settings if you use ChatGPT for work purposes.

**Practical tip:** Check your ChatGPT privacy settings today and turn off history saving if you use it to handle work-related or sensitive information.

featured.quote: Australian organisations face critical vulnerability exposure due to widespread patch management backlogs across the region.
